posts.title: I am now on Bluesky!
posts.description: After two years of my absence on social media, I am returning to social media after all! You can follow me on Bluesky if you want: https://bsky.app/profile/oocjz.bsky.social As a result of my return to having a presence on social media, my personal blog is no longer a hybrid microblog-blog.

posts.title: Going all-in on the blue color!
posts.description: After 7 years of having the yellow color in my identity, we've decided to drop that one color from my identity in conjunction with the introduction of the second generation of me. The second generation of me also includes a brand new persona alongside a new timeless logo that fits every graphic design aesthetics including Frutiger Aero and Liquid Glass.

posts.title: SMG4 finally throws in the towel for good
posts.description: Good news, Luke Lerdwichagul has announced that is ending his original YouTube channel, SMG4 in December 2025 as he turns to indie animation (Glitch Productions) entirely. Others such as SML had to be changed as a result of a cease and desist from Nintendo for its unauthorized permission of the company's characters.
